body:
Subject: BUG-1236 (high) — drive PRs carry the hold marker but not the GitHub label

While watching wave followups-0918e: BUG-1229 (drive) reached the merge point, the marker was written (aida merge-hold list shows it, so merge_change refuses), but PR #1943 had no aida:merge-hold label, so the required merge-hold-gate check read PASS. Same was true of #1895 and #1897 last night. sync_label runs gh pr edit with stderr discarded and only at merge execution. I labelled #1943 by hand (gate now held) and filed BUG-1236 with the fix shape (label at PR-open, surface sync failures, merge-hold list --fix). Until it lands, please treat "merge-hold-gate = pass" as NOT proof a supervised PR is unheld; the marker is the truth. #1943 is at your gate once its reviewer round finishes.
